# Rule: Internal base class leaks through a public type

_Canonical rule slug:_ `detail-base-class-changed`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> A public class inherits from an internal one, so a change to the internal base relocates the public object's members.

- [case74_detail_base_class_changed](../case74_detail_base_class_changed.md) — Internal `detail::` base class layout change leaks via public API (🔴 BREAKING)
